## What's new in v0.3.2

- Fixed page backgrounds: AuraView now respects each website's own styles instead of forcing a dark background onto every page.
- Pages without a background color now use the standard white browser canvas, keeping default black text readable. Websites with their own dark themes retain their styling.

## Windows installers

Choose either the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** from the assets below. Both install AuraView v0.3.2 for Windows x64 and include the video download tools.
